source.weight_base: same BF16 original checkpoint for all modes

execution.worker: BEGLIN native qwen_infer C compiled in separate research checkout; actual full model
execution.common_head: same tied embedding FP32 output head in all modes; NO standalone Q8 head
execution.nonprojection_weights: F32 widened from original BF16 in all runs

f32.baseline_reference: source BF16 weights widened to FP32; NOT native BF16 compute

packed4.encoding: BEGLIN Q4G64 4-bit group64 with error feedback

scope_limits: One public synthetic prompt and its final logits; no heldout sentiment-task AUROC, perplexity or multiple independent prompts measured.
F32 BF16-widened weight baseline does not measure native BF16 execution precision.
No full-model decode tokens/sec, process resident memory, Apple Metal GPU, or Joule/energy measurements.
An identical argmax token does not imply similar logits: packed4 had 0.245 nats KL.
No source-anchored 24 V6 holdout exclusion attestation; final Q acceptance is SEALED.
The research-only precision switch changes a SHA-verified lab COPY of qwen_infer.c. Original tracked source and production unchanged.
